items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: But my point was, I loved Miles and we would hang out, he cooked for me, he's a great cook.

ctx.x: But my point was, I loved Miles and we would hang out, he cooked for me, he's a great cook. He cooks fish and some greens and all kinds of stuff, and was really interested in my music. But then in his book he said I couldn't play and stuff, I had a sign. But you know, he's like a bunch of different guys, and he was always on my case about coming to play with him, but I never did it.
